sentence: This project studies whether disease-causing mutations affect how mitochondria move in dopaminergic neurons in mouse models of Parkinson's disease.
This project tries to find out how to help the aortic wall heal so that aortic dissection and rupture can be prevented.
This project studies what the inflammasome in liver cells called hepatocytes does in alcoholic liver disease.
This project builds ways to make nuclear magnetic resonance work on larger systems, with better sensitivity and automated data acquisition.
This project builds an assay that detects three kinds of RNA modification in mRNA at the same time.
This project tries to find out whether clinicians viewing health records from outside institutions changes care and patient satisfaction.
This project studies how mammalian cells move mRNAs to specific places in the cell so proteins are made in the right location.
This project builds an imaging method to stage radiation-induced lung injury and compares conventional radiation therapy with ultra-high dose radiation.
This project studies how adhesion molecules control the barrier of endothelial cells in the lung during inflammation and restoration.
This project studies what nuclear heparan-sulfated proteins do in the stem cells that make blood cells.
This project uses human fetal adrenal organoids grown from stem cells to study how the adrenal cortex develops and makes steroid hormones.
This project studies what causes airway cells to take over alveoli surfaces in pulmonary fibrosis, using mice that carry rare mutations.
This project tries to find a way to engineer red blood cells directly in the body for uses such as drug delivery.
This project studies how adeno-associated virus vectors work in the mouse brain to improve transcription after gene therapy.
This project builds HIV vaccines from killed bacteria with reduced genomes that show viral antigens on their surfaces.
This project uses machine learning to predict specific outcomes of Crohn's disease from genetic signatures and patient biopsies.
This project studies how proteins made from circular RNA activate drivers of glioblastoma and lead it to escape targeted therapies.
This project builds computational tools that help tell pathogenic genetic variants from benign ones and study their effects across species.
This project studies lipid nanoparticles that reach the heart, to build ways to deliver RNA-based therapies for heart failure.
